parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Use velocity continuity at $t=8$ to form a linear equation in $k$ only: $30.6-0.9(8)=1600/8^2+8k$. Allow one slip in a value or sign only.
A1: $k=-0.2$.
DM1: Set the correct final velocity expression equal to zero with their negative $k$ and find a positive stopping time; reference value $t=20$.
*M1: Attempt to integrate $v$ over one of the three intervals; increase the power by 1 with a coefficient change in at least one matching term; $s=vt$ is M0.
A1: For $0\leq t\leq2$, $s=7.2t^3/3+c$; may be unsimplified.
A1: For $2\leq t\leq8$, $s=30.6t-0.9t^2/2+c$; may be unsimplified.
A1FT: For $8\leq t\leq20$, $s=-1600t^{-1}+(k/2)t^2+c$; may be unsimplified; follow through their $k$ or use symbolic $k$.
B1: One correct interval distance: $19.2$, $156.6$ or $\pm86.4$; allow unsimplified equivalent such as $216-59.4$ or a trapezium expression.
B1: Distance $=19.2+(216-59.4)+[-120-(-206.4)]=262.2$ m; this mark may be awarded without shown integration; equivalent $1311/5$; condone $262$ www.
Printed total: 9.
